checks.claim: Concrete footings anchor a shelter's posts against wind uplift.
checks.why: Installer and engineering guides: post bases set in concrete footings resist wind uplift and lateral loads.

checks.claim: Paving slabs are laid on a compacted sub-base so they stay level.
checks.why: Guides call for a compacted sub-base; soft spots otherwise sink into dips within months.

sources.title: How to Lay a Patio & Paving Slabs (Screwfix)

checks.claim: A gutter collects roof runoff and sends it to a downspout.
checks.why: County guidance: gutters collect roof rainwater and direct it to the ground via a downspout.

checks.claim: A rain barrel under a downspout stores roof water for the garden.
checks.why: Extension services describe barrels at downspouts that collect roof runoff for watering gardens.
